conventions.positions: Reuse Skyfield 1.54 / DE440s apparent geocentric true ecliptic/equinox of date, seven classical planets; existing Western behavior unchanged.
conventions.anchor_definition: 1956-03-21 00:00 TT, revised IAE1985 Lahiri 23 degrees 15 minutes 0.658 seconds; not original ICRC 0.000 seconds or fixed-star true-Citra.
conventions.transport: Remove Skyfield IAU2000A longitude nutation at anchor. Rotate date mean-ecliptic equinox through ICRS to anchor mean ecliptic using Skyfield Capitaine et al. 2003 precession. Subtract its anchor-frame longitude from mean anchor. Add date longitude nutation for true ayanamsha; subtract true ayanamsha from apparent longitude/Ascendant.
conventions.model_limit: Explicit Skyfield realization, not bit-identical to Swiss default Vondrak/IAU1980 realization. Exploratory 1850–2149 comparisons differ about 0.14 arcsecond; no empirical fitted correction applied.
conventions.nodes: IERS2010 chapter 5 equation 5.43 mean lunar ascending-node polynomial in TT centuries; add longitude nutation to express tropical true-equinox node; Ketu exactly opposite. No true/osculating node fallback.
conventions.speeds: Differentiate sidereal coordinates, including ayanamsha drift; retrograde is the sidereal longitude derivative sign.
conventions.scope: Astronomical epochs 1850–2149; core locations abs(latitude)<66 degrees. Pinned IANA civil input, explicit DST fold, rejected gaps; inherited modeled UT1 and pre-1972 proleptic UTC limits.

boundary_semantics: Half-open sectors; machine-level rational-edge snaps within 1e-12 sector units. Values within .01 degree of a boundary flagged, not certified birth-time precision.
predictive_validity: Symbolic tradition; numerical/reference agreement does not establish real-world predictive accuracy.
